definition-changed.answer: The rule's 'class condition' is the condition form (§2002:8.8.4.1.3), not class of a data item; the 2002 class-condition words are the reader's scope. Scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Invoked by 'arithmetic expression' (sign condition without it). The rule classifies a selection object by its leftmost token; evaluation mode (§2002:8.8.1.1, 'regardless of the mode of arithmetic') does not enter. No dependence.
